2610.09212.title: CurveTQ: Rotation-Free Trellis Quantization of LLM Weights via Curvature-Weighted Search
2610.09212.paper_summary: The best two-bit weight quantizers for large language models, such as QTIP and Proteus, rotate each weight matrix by a random orthogonal transform, which must be undone at every decoding step, then encode it with a trellis or lattice code under a Euclidean search; the layer Hessian enters only through error feedback between coding blocks. We show that this leaves part of the Hessian unused. Error feedback turns the loss into a weighted sum of per-coordinate rounding errors whose weights, the diagonal of the Hessian's LDL factorization, existing quantizers compute but never read. We put these weights into the Viterbi branch metric, so the search follows the curvature within each coding block. This also explains the rotation: it removes this within-block variation, so weighting in the native basis and rotating are substitutes. On three models the weighted native search matches a full-dimension randomized Hadamard to within about one point of downstream accuracy, and weighting after the rotation gains little. Around this search we build CurveTQ, a trellis codec with no rotation, which handles the weights' amplitude and marginal shape with a factored scale field and a closed-form quantile table, and stores a start state per coding block so the trellis can adapt to the residual that error feedback carries into it. At two bits CurveTQ is 1-3 points higher in mean downstream accuracy than QTIP and Proteus on three 4-8B Instruct models, even after both are given our start state, which alone lifts either baseline by 1-3 points. It also leads on a 35B mixture of experts, to our knowledge the first trellis-coded result on such a model. With no rotation to undo, our decoder is the fastest of the three at all tested batch sizes and bit widths.
2610.09212.paper_summary_zh: 最佳的兩位元權重量化器，像是 QTIP 和 Proteus，通過隨機正交變換旋轉每個權重矩陣，這必須在每個解碼步驟中被撤銷，然後在歐幾里得搜索下用樹狀碼或格碼進行編碼；層海森矩陣僅通過編碼區塊之間的錯誤反饋進入。我們顯示這會導致部分海森矩陣未被使用。錯誤反饋將損失轉換為每個坐標四捨五入誤差的加權總和，其權重為海森矩陣 LDL 分解的對角線，現有的量化器計算但從不讀取。我們將這些權重放入 Viterbi 分支度量中，因此搜索遵循每個編碼區塊內的曲率。這也解釋了旋轉：它消除了這種區塊內變異，因此在本地基底中的加權和旋轉是替代品。在三個模型上，加權的本地搜索與全維隨機哈達瑪德的準確度相差約一點，而旋轉後的加權增益不大。在這個搜索的基礎上，我們構建了 CurveTQ，一個沒有旋轉的樹狀編解碼器，它使用分解的尺度場和封閉形式的分位數表來處理權重的幅度和邊際形狀，並為每個編碼區塊存儲一個起始狀態，以便樹狀編碼器可以適應錯誤反饋帶入的殘差。在兩位元的情況下，CurveTQ 在三個 4-8B 指令模型上的平均下游準確度比 QTIP 和 Proteus 高出 1-3 點，即使在兩者都給予我們的起始狀態後，僅此一項就能使任一基線提升 1-3 點。它在 35B 專家混合模型上也領先，據我們所知，這是這樣模型上第一個樹狀編碼的結果。由於沒有需要撤銷的旋轉，我們的解碼器在所有測試的批量大小和位寬中都是三者中最快的。
